gitCommit.subject: Portal evidence: an idempotency key is recorded masked, never as its value
gitCommit.body:
Portal evidence: an idempotency key is recorded masked, never as its value

The portal browser test's evidence is committed to ci-evidence, and CI's full-history secret scan reads every branch:
the claim's generated idempotencyKey matched gitleaks' generic-api-key rule (9 findings, now in .gitleaksignore).
record() writes "[masked: N characters]" in its place. Checked here: the claim tests pass in EN/FR/AR, and gitleaks
(CI's image) finds nothing in the new evidence while it flags an unmasked control copy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
